title: Claude Code Agent Teams
author: Simone Rizzo, @simonerizzo98
version: Claude Code Agent Teams as described in the post
claims: The creator describes a team lead, parallel agents, separate tasks, communication among team members, and shared files or task state.
limits: I read a public transcript and caption through TTAnon. I did not watch the video. The transcript has speech recognition errors. Views and engagement shown on the mirror are a snapshot, not a ranking or quality measure.
evidence_pointer: TTAnon page for the TikTok video, transcript lines 67-74, caption lines 32-35. The transcript says the team feature was experimental at the time of recording.

title: Agent Teams in Claude Code, explained

title: One Claude with skills often beats a team of subagents
author: Vibe with Kevin, @vibewithkevin
version: Claude Code workflow and Anthropic guidance cited in the post
claims: The creator recommends a test before removing a specialist subagent. The proposed test uses ten requests with known answers and two runs per request. The creator reports a support example where a folded specialist instruction failed to preserve a shipping constraint.
limits: I read the public transcript and post details through TTAnon. I did not watch the video. The reported support example is the creator's anecdote, not a reproduced test. The post does not report results from the proposed ten-request test.
evidence_pointer: TTAnon page for the TikTok video, lines 11-34 and transcript at lines 77-78. The mirror showed 1.3K views, 65 likes, 2 comments, 8 shares, and 47 saves when retrieved.

title: git-worktree manual
author: Git project
claims: A repository can have linked working trees. Each working tree has its own working directory and checkout state. The manual documents add, list, lock, move, prune, remove, and repair operations.
limits: Git documents repository behavior. It does not promise that parallel coding agents will avoid semantic conflicts or merge errors.
evidence_pointer: DESCRIPTION and COMMANDS sections of the official git-worktree manual.

title: Create custom subagents
author: Anthropic
claims: Claude Code subagents can use separate context, focused prompts, and limited tools. The documentation describes when to use subagents, parallel work, result handoff, and context management.
limits: This documents Claude Code. It does not establish equivalent behavior in Codex or other products. Product behavior can change.
evidence_pointer: Read Work with subagents, Choose between subagents and main conversation, Run subagents in foreground or background, and Manage subagent context.

title: How we built our multi-agent research system
author: Anthropic Engineering
claims: Anthropic reports that parallel agents helped with open-ended research tasks and describes added coordination, evaluation, and reliability challenges.
limits: The report concerns Anthropic's research system. It does not show that parallel code agents improve routine repository tasks.
evidence_pointer: Benefits of a multi-agent system and Architecture overview for Research. The article states that the system uses parallel agents to search simultaneously and that multi-agent systems add coordination, evaluation, and reliability challenges.

title: Effect House AI Overview
